description: Structural template for the investor one-pager and the follow-up email set. Defines the fields analyzed in every deck, the sections rendered on the page, and the layout and typography of each block. Contains no company-specific content: every value here is structure, label, or style.

analysis_fields.company_name: The company name exactly as written in the deck.
analysis_fields.tagline: One-line positioning statement or descriptor for the company.
analysis_fields.problem: The problem the company addresses, in 1-3 sentences.
analysis_fields.solution: The product or technology and how it works, in 1-3 sentences.
analysis_fields.why_now: The timing thesis: why this opportunity exists at this moment.
analysis_fields.market_size: TAM/SAM/SOM figures and the market narrative, with any stated sources.
analysis_fields.traction: Revenue, users, growth, pilots, grants, or other concrete traction metrics.
analysis_fields.business_model: How the company makes money: pricing, model, transaction structure.
analysis_fields.team: Key founders and executives with the background stated in the deck.
analysis_fields.ask: Raise amount, instrument, and use of funds.
analysis_fields.stage: Company stage, e.g. Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, as stated or clearly labeled.
analysis_fields.key_risks_retired: De-risking already achieved: validation, approvals, partnerships.
analysis_fields.competitive_moat: IP, exclusivity, network effects, or other stated defensibility.
analysis_fields.contact: Founder or contact name and email address if present in the deck.

angles.title: Timing & Inflection
angles.focus: Near-term data, launch, or regulatory inflection; why this moment is pre-repricing.

angles.title: De-Risking & Validation
angles.focus: Risks already retired and external validation from customers, regulators, partners, or non-dilutive funding.

angles.title: Market Structural Shift
angles.focus: A recent change in market behavior, regulation, infrastructure, or cost curves; why earlier attempts at this category failed and this one will not.

angles.title: Capital Efficiency & Ownership
angles.focus: Why capital today funds value creation rather than discovery, and how early capital compounds.
angles.goal: Appeal to disciplined angels and family offices.

angles.title: Soft Ask & Re-Engagement
angles.focus: Relevance rather than pressure; invite a next step without assuming interest.
